{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID_SEARCH
filtered = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_total = len(filtered)
n_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total

print(f"Total NEW customers in PAID_SEARCH: {n_total}")
print(f"Converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_rate"}
